12508.name: Jaxson Dart
12508.reason: Torn MCL + meniscus and PCL sprain in Wk2 vs LAR; knee surgery ends his 2026 season (6-9 month recovery). Jameis Winston starts. Sleeper still projects ~20/wk from Wk4 (stale).

5850.name: Josh Jacobs
5850.reason: Still on the commissioner's exempt list (since Aug 30); pleaded no contest to misdemeanor battery/property damage, and the NFL's personal-conduct review (possible suspension) has no announced end. Cannot practice or play. Sleeper assumes a Wk8 return; a reinstatement or time-served suspension could bring him back midseason.
5850.source: NBC Sports/PFT exempt-list update; Sleeper tag NA/Personal

10222.name: Jayden Reed
10222.reason: Neck injury on a hard hit in Wk2 at NYJ, carted off on a spine board, hospitalized overnight (movement in all extremities). LaFleur says it is 'way too early' to know whether he plays again this season. Taken as out through Wk12 with a diminished role if he returns; he was already WR6 on the depth chart.
10222.source: NBC Sports 2026-09-22 'Packers unsure if Reed plays this season'; ESPN

11566.name: Jayden Daniels
11566.reason: Dislocated left elbow (no fracture) late in the first half of Wk2 at DAL; seeing specialists, no timeline yet. Mariota starts Wk3. Same elbow he dislocated last season, when he missed 3 games; a repeat dislocation raises instability/surgery risk. Expect a brace and fewer designed runs on return.
11566.source: ESPN/NFL.com/NBC Sports 2026-09-21..23 (Mariota to start Wk3, awaiting specialist opinions)

8142.name: Alec Pierce
8142.reason: Aggravated the heel he had surgically repaired this offseason (carted off in Wk2 vs KC). Placed on IR (minimum 4 games, Wk3-6); rehabbing rather than repeat surgery, 'several weeks' with hope of a midseason return. Surgery still possible.
8142.source: NBC Sports 2026-09-23 (IR); ESPN 'out weeks, hoping to return midseason'; CBS

11583.name: Jonathon Brooks
11583.reason: Core-muscle (groin/abdomen) surgery Sept 23 after a Wk2 injury; placed on IR, expected to miss ~6 weeks (CAR bye Wk5), so Wk9 is the realistic return. Was RB3 behind Hubbard anyway.
11583.source: AP via US News 2026-09-23 (6 weeks); ESPN; CBS

5859.name: A.J. Brown
5859.reason: High-ankle sprain in Wk1 vs SEA; IR since Sept 11, reported ~6-week absence. IR-eligible Wk6, realistic return Wk7-8; Wk7 included as out. Sleeper agrees (0 through Wk7).
5859.source: NFL.com (6 weeks), NBC Sports Boston (IR, min Wk6)

4033.name: David Njoku
4033.reason: Fibula injury, carted off in Wk2 vs LV; placed on IR Sept 21 (minimum 4 games, Wk3-6), LAC bye Wk7. Unclear if more serious than the IR minimum. Was TE3 on the depth chart (16% of snaps in Wk2 before the injury).

13281.name: Jordyn Tyson
13281.reason: Rookie hamstring strain (Aug 13); IR-designated-to-return, reported ~2 months out. Wk7 international game + Wk8 bye make Wk9 the likeliest debut (Sleeper has Wk6-7 trickle).

9753.name: Zach Charbonnet
9753.reason: Reserve/PUP after Feb ACL surgery: must miss through Wk4 (eligible Wk5). SEA did NOT open his 21-day practice window this week, though Macdonald says a start date is 'coming soon', so Wk5 is optimistic; Wk6 assumed. Must re-win work from Price (and Holani/Wilson). Sleeper zeroes the whole season (PUP artifact).
9753.source: FantasyPros/CBS 2026-09-23 (window not opened this week); Field Gulls (Macdonald quote)

5022.name: Dallas Goedert
5022.reason: MCL sprain in Wk2 vs TEN; expected to 'miss a few weeks' and back this season; IR still possible (would mean at least Wk3-6). PHI signed Zach Ertz to the practice squad. Sleeper zeroes Wk3-4 only.

12469.name: Dylan Sampson
12469.reason: Knee injury on a Wk1 kickoff return; IR, minimum 4 games, eligible Wk6 vs BAL. RB6 on the depth chart, so negligible impact; Sleeper zeroes his entire season.

13293.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
13293.reason: Fractured wrist in Wk1, surgery, IR (minimum 4 games); eligible Wk6 at CLE. WR10 on the depth chart.

13417.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
13417.reason: Moved from Out to IR with ankle surgery noted (Sleeper, Sept 19). No dedicated reporting found; an IR stint started before Wk2 covers at least Wk2-5, and Sleeper zeroes him until Wk16. Out through the Wk8 bye assumed. WR10, negligible impact.

7569.name: Nico Collins
7569.reason: Grade 1 hamstring strain from Wk2 practice; missed Wk2 and reported not expected to play Wk3 vs IND (would be a second straight missed game). Timeline still 'fluid' since hamstrings are unpredictable, but no long-term structural issue reported.
7569.source: CBS Sports ('week-to-week'), Yahoo/Reuters ('unlikely to face Colts') 2026-09-24

9493.name: Puka Nacua
9493.reason: Groin soreness; inactive in Wk2, DNP again Wednesday; McVay 'not sure' he plays Wk3 vs DEN (one doctor floated sports-hernia risk). Coin flip - taken as out. Sleeper still projects 17.2 in Wk3.

4199.name: Aaron Jones
4199.reason: Knee injury in Wk2 (finished in a brace after 23 carries/81% snaps); DNP Wednesday, O'Connell calls him uncertain for Wk3 at TB. Coin flip - taken as out. Role was clearly RB1 with Jordan Mason on IR.

4943.name: Sam Darnold
4943.reason: 'Unique' short-term glute soft-tissue injury from Wk1; missed Wk2. Ramping up in practice this week with 'at least a chance' to play Wk3 at WAS; decision by Friday. Coin flip - sided with Sleeper (0 in Wk3). Original estimate was ~4 weeks.

8210.name: Chig Okonkwo
8210.reason: Hamstring from Wk1; missed Wk2, DNP Wednesday and 'in rehab mode' per Quinn.

13296.name: Caleb Douglas
13296.reason: Ankle injury late in Wk2 (in a boot postgame); DNP Wednesday, Hafley non-committal for Wk3 vs KC.

11604.name: Brock Bowers
11604.reason: Meniscus trim before the season; missed Wks1-2. Practicing and expected to debut Wk3 vs NO (Rapoport). Expect a managed snap share for his first couple of games.

9997.name: Zay Flowers
9997.reason: Aggravated hamstring (Wk1 after 150 yds in a half), missed Wk2, DNP Wednesday again; Minter says he has a 'good shot' to play Wk3 vs DAL (Rio). Re-aggravation risk.

4983.name: DJ Moore
4983.reason: Left AC-joint sprain in Wk2 (TNF); not considered serious, 'has a chance to play' Wk3 vs LAC with 10 days of rest, but not a lock.

11632.name: Malik Nabers
11632.reason: Right shoulder popped out and he popped it back in during Wk2; returned to the game and was limited Wednesday. Expected to play; recurrence risk.

4866.name: Saquon Barkley
4866.reason: Stinger on his first Wk2 carry (only 12 of 76 snaps); MRI described as precautionary, 'not more than a stinger'. Expected to play Wk3.

12489.name: RJ Harvey
12489.reason: Hamstring; inactive in Wk2, limited Wednesday and 'continues to make progress'. With Dobbins (hip) limited and Coleman (ankle) DNP, he could reclaim a lead share if active.

6806.name: J.K. Dobbins
6806.reason: Hip/hamstring (tag says hamstring, Gazette says hip) after exiting Wk2; limited Wednesday; Payton 'we're going to be alright'. Only 34% of snaps in Wk2.

13345.name: Jonah Coleman
13345.reason: Rookie ankle injury; DNP Wednesday. His Wk2 production (25 snaps, TD) came with Harvey inactive and Dobbins hurt - if Harvey returns he falls back to RB3. Availability and role both in doubt for Wk3.

7021.name: Rico Dowdle
7021.reason: Toe injury, DNP Wednesday in a walking boot, but Rapoport calls it day-to-day and not serious. Role concern too: Warren took 71% of snaps in Wk2 vs Dowdle's 26% (reversal of Wk1's 58/37).
7021.source: Behind the Steel Curtain / RotoWire 2026-09-23; snap data Wks1-2

8228.name: Jaylen Warren
8228.reason: Shoulder (Sleeper: undisclosed); limited Wednesday. Won the PIT backfield in Wk2 (71% of snaps), and Dowdle's toe could add volume.

6819.name: Michael Pittman
6819.reason: Foot injury (different from his camp injury) kept him out of Wk2; back at practice limited Wednesday. Needs a full session by Friday to avoid a tag.

7543.name: Travis Etienne
7543.reason: Hamstring, limited Wednesday (first appearance on the report). Also sharing more with the returning Alvin Kamara (54% of snaps, 8 carries in Wk2).
7543.source: Saints Wk3 injury report via Audacy/RotoBaller 2026-09-23

12534.name: Kyle Monangai
12534.reason: Hamstring (Sleeper: undisclosed); missing/limited at practice ahead of CHI's Monday game. Could see extra volume if Caleb Williams and Bagent are out.

2216.name: Mike Evans
2216.reason: Hip injury in Wk2 (left in the second half of a blowout); Shanahan says it will be 'managed', not considered serious.

5967.name: Tony Pollard
5967.reason: Ankle soreness (Sleeper: undisclosed); DNP Wednesday but Saleh did not indicate he is at real risk of sitting out.

13286.name: Jadarian Price
13286.reason: Left Wk2 with what SEA now calls a shoulder issue ('intact, nothing serious'); X-rays negative, limited Wednesday. Could lose share when Charbonnet returns (handled separately).

12048.name: George Holani
12048.reason: Knee; limited Wednesday. RB3 with a 26% snap share in Wk2 - minor impact.

11646.name: Jalen Coker
11646.reason: Ankle; limited Wednesday again (played through the same issue in Wk2 with 76% of snaps). Availability not in question.

5947.name: Jakobi Meyers
5947.reason: Thumb; no reporting suggesting risk of missing time. Played 90% of snaps in Wk2 (1 target).

7611.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
7611.reason: Role loss: fumbled early in Wk2 and was out-snapped 33-20 (60% vs 36%) by TreVeyon Henderson in Henderson's season debut; Henderson got 16 carries to his 6. Wk1's 85% share came with Henderson (ankle) inactive. Sleeper still projects ~12/wk.
7611.source: CBS 'outplayed by Henderson', 98.5 snap counts 2026-09-21; s26_w1/w2 snap data
